author: Jared Coughlin
title: Apple (AAPL) Price Target Raised to $225.00
text:
Posted by Jared Coughlin on Jun 11th, 2018 // No Comments
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) had its target price upped by Argus from $210.00 to $225.00 in a research note issued to investors on Friday morning. Argus currently has a buy rating on the iPhone maker’s stock.
Several other equities analysts also recently weighed in on AAPL. ValuEngine downgraded shares of Apple from a buy rating to a hold rating in a research note on Thursday, February 8th. Bank of America reiterated an outperform rating and issued a $220.00 target price on shares of Apple in a research note on Thursday, February 8th. Vetr downgraded shares of Apple from a strong-buy rating to a buy rating and set a $187.18 target price for the company. in a research note on Wednesday, February 14th. Raymond James reiterated a market perform rating on shares of Apple in a research note on Friday, February 16th. Finally, BidaskClub upgraded shares of Apple from a sell rating to a hold rating in a research note on Saturday, February 17th. One investment analyst has rated the stock with a sell rating, seventeen have issued a hold rating, thirty-one have assigned a buy rating and two have given a strong buy rating to the stock. Apple presently has an average rating of Buy and a consensus target price of $205.87. Get Apple alerts:
Apple opened at $191.70 on Friday, according to MarketBeat Ratings . The stock has a market capitalization of $972.69 billion, a PE ratio of 20.81, a price-to-earnings-growth ratio of 1.58 and a beta of 1.29. The company has a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.80, a current ratio of 1.46 and a quick ratio of 1.37. Apple has a twelve month low of $142.20 and a twelve month high of $194.20. Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last posted its earnings results on Tuesday, May 1st. The iPhone maker reported $2.73 earnings per share for the quarter, topping the consensus estimate of $2.69 by $0.04. The firm had revenue of $61.14 billion during the quarter, compared to the consensus estimate of $60.94 billion. Apple had a net margin of 21.55% and a return on equity of 39.97%. The company’s revenue was up 15.6% on a year-over-year basis. During the same quarter last year, the company earned $2.10 earnings per share. equities research analysts anticipate that Apple will post 11.42 EPS for the current fiscal year.
Apple announced that its board has approved a share buyback plan on Tuesday, May 1st that permits the company to buyback $100.00 billion in shares. This buyback authorization permits the iPhone maker to repurchase up to 11.9% of its stock through open market purchases. Stock buyback plans are often a sign that the company’s leadership believes its stock is undervalued.
The company also recently declared a quarterly dividend, which was paid on Thursday, May 17th. Investors of record on Monday, May 14th were issued a dividend of $0.73 per share. This is a positive change from Apple’s previous quarterly dividend of $0.63. This represents a $2.92 dividend on an annualized basis and a yield of 1.52%. The ex-dividend date was Friday, May 11th. Apple’s dividend payout ratio is currently 31.70%.
In related news, insider Philip W. Schiller sold 69,491 shares of the company’s stock in a transaction on Tuesday, April 3rd. The shares were sold at an average price of $166.42, for a total transaction of $11,564,692.22. The transaction was disclosed in a document filed with the Securities & Exchange Commission, which is available through this link . Also, insider Luca Maestri sold 4,769 shares of the company’s stock in a transaction on Friday, June 1st. The shares were sold at an average price of $189.54, for a total transaction of $903,916.26. Following the sale, the insider now owns 68,044 shares of the company’s stock, valued at $12,897,059.76. The disclosure for this sale can be found here . Insiders have sold a total of 256,853 shares of company stock valued at $45,378,566 over the last quarter. 0.06% of the stock is currently owned by company insiders.
A number of large investors have recently bought and sold shares of AAPL. Quattro Financial Advisors LLC purchased a new position in Apple during the 1st quarter valued at $133,000. Smart Portfolios LLC purchased a new position in Apple during the 1st quarter valued at $134,000. Spectrum Financial Alliance Ltd LLC purchased a new position in Apple during the 1st quarter valued at $138,000. Macroview Investment Management LLC increased its position in Apple by 220.3% during the 1st quarter. Macroview Investment Management LLC now owns 900 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $151,000 after purchasing an additional 619 shares during the period. Finally, Oak Point Wealth Management purchased a new position in Apple during the 4th quarter valued at $163,000. Institutional investors own 58.13% of the company’s stock.
About Apple
